feature: Value graph zoom and segment Easing in the timeline bar
summary: An open value graph now zooms taller or shorter with Option and the wheel over it, and a double click on its range readings fits it again. With only segments of the line picked, the timeline bar shows Easing naming their curve and sets it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/value-graph-zoom-and-segment-easing-walk.json

try.do: Add a title, animate its Scale from 100% at 0:01 to 200% at 0:03, and click Graph in the panel's Animating row.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Hold Option and scroll up over the graph.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Hold Option and scroll down over the graph to zoom back out past the fit.
Double-click the 200% reading at the graph's top left.
Click the line between the two points.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open Easing at the right of the timeline bar and choose Ease out.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Does Option and the wheel over a graph zooming its values, and not time, feel right, given that the same gesture zooms time everywhere else on the timeline?
Is a double click on the readings an easy enough way back to the fit, or do you want a visible Fit control?
With a segment picked, does the bar's Easing read as the curve of that segment at a glance?
Does the zoomed curve stopping at the graph's top and bottom read clearly, or do you want a hint that it continues?
rough: No mock covers zooming the graph: the mock's graph always fits itself, so the gesture and the double-click reset are this task's own answer.
Over an open graph Option and the wheel zoom its values instead of time; move the pointer off the graph (or pinch) to zoom time. Pinching over the graph still zooms time and rows as before.
With keys and segments picked together, the bar still offers the key list and sets only the keys, where the mock says it sets everything picked: the-timeline-bar-easing-sets-picked-segments-too.
A point zoomed past the top or bottom of the graph is hidden rather than pinned to the edge, so there is no mark saying a point is out of view.
Shutting the graph forgets its zoom; it opens fitted next time.
